description.value: Nesters Market SFU is a full-service neighbourhood grocery store located in the UniverCity community on Burnaby Mountain, adjacent to Simon Fraser University. Part of the BC-founded Nesters chain (established Whistler, 1987) and now operated by the Jim Pattison Group, this location offers fresh produce, natural and organic products, an in-store bakery, deli and bistro, and a pharmacy. It serves both campus residents and the surrounding hillside community, making it a useful resupply stop for cyclists on routes through the Burnaby Mountain area.
